high_level_description: The image is a collage of three photos featuring the same woman posing outdoors at night. She is wearing an elegant black dress with intricate lace detailing on the bodice and skirt. The dress has a deep V-neckline and a high slit on one side, revealing her leg. She accessorizes with a small, black handbag and strappy black heels. In the background, there is a street scene with parked cars and a building that appears to be a hotel or a similar establishment. The lighting suggests it is nighttime, and the area looks well-lit, possibly due to streetlights or building lights.
